scope: All 39 changed Linux screenshot candidates listed in evidence/ux-improvements-20261027/visual-changes.json. No baseline or source changes made.

coverage.method: Every full-page and viewport candidate inspected at original pixel resolution. Desktop strips are at most 1450 pixels high; phone strips are at most 1400 pixels high and arranged in columns without resizing. Adjacent strips overlap by 60 pixels. Added labels and strip boundaries are inspection artifacts. home-viewport-01 and floating-tools-home have identical SHA256; their identical pixels were inspected once.

findings.title: Keep floating controls clear of mobile prose
findings.description: At the 390px phone width, the fixed 48px chat launcher occupies x approximately 326-374 and y approximately 780-828, overlapping body text in about, pricing and work. The scrolled floating-tools-content capture also shows both fixed controls over the local-example disclosure. Pricing obscures cost/optional-care wording. Desktop controls sit outside content and phone inquiry forms are clear.
findings.required_resolution: Change the mobile control placement or visibility so ordinary text remains readable, then recapture affected mobile states and review before accepting their baselines.
findings.regression_attribution: Observed in candidate pixels; this static review does not establish whether the underlying control behavior predates this commit.

limits: Acceptance applies only to the supplied static screenshot states and exact hashes, not all scrolling positions, interactive states or routes.
No new P1 issue or additional layout defect observed.
Sticky header coverage at the top of mid-scroll viewport captures and text crossing artificial inspection-strip edges are not classified as defects.
